title: An anonymous frontier physicist's experience

tellings.quote: another friend who I'll I'll remain anonymous, but he's a very high level physicist

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels mentions a friend he keeps anonymous, a physicist he describes as working at a very high level. Michels says this friend had an experience of his own, but in the telling gives no details of what happened, where or when. It is raised to suggest that serious scientists have such stories too.
